Name: PFM - Resource Recycling - Wood Stone and Sap
Author: Neverward
Description:
This mod carefully balances input value and crafting times to make sure that it is not overpowered in early game, and still a useful way to make a little side cash. All items are created using the vanilla recycling machine. The items themselves are purely for export purposes and not used in any crafting recipes.

[b]Details on Production:[/b]
Wood - Firewood / 20 wood and 2 sap make 1 Firewood.
Base value of materials: 44g
Value after process: 200g
Time for processing: 1200 minutes (20 hours)

Stone - Pavers / 20 stone and 4 fiber make 1 Pavers
Base value of materials: 44g
Value after process: 275g
Time for processing: 1200 minutes (20 hours)

Sap - Wood Glue / 10 sap makes 1 Glue
Base Value of Materials: 20g
Value after Process: 120g
Time for processing: 600 minutes (10 hours)

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Producer Framework Mod
Json Assets
(Recommended for automate users: PFMautomate)

[b]Final Thoughts:
[/b]If you have any ideas or suggestions please feel free to leave a comment or message me directly. I am happy to add more items.
Special thanks to Nuztalgia and Lenin for offering support through the mod creation process. <3
